feeds.title: The Polygamist's Daughter
feeds.description: Hii! I am Victoria. I began writing this blog as a way of expressing my thoughts about polygamy and growing up in a cult as I came to my own understanding and awareness of the difference between religion and spirituality. The focus of my work is teaching spiritual freedom and spirituality from the perspective of the Divine Feminine as I came to embrace my spiritual gifts outside of religious dogma.
